subject: mth
title: (R)MTH.------AF.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 254 (CMBA-10). MTH (methodology) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names AF-DY (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: SOC-RT-DEVF (social reality diversification), VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From VT-DY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From EXT-FT: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From MT-DEVF: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From ACC-FT: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: IST-PT (isolated particulars). From IST-PT: LANG-DY (language dynamics).
